response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS benchmark FROM per) SELECT per.rating, per.avg_rate_per_day, per.film_count, per.avg_rate_per_day / bench.benchmark AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per CROSS JOIN bench WHERE bench.benchmark IS NOT NULL
